topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by recapping prior practical work, outlining the learning outcomes, and framing the day's subject matter.

topics.label: Tumor viruses, proto-oncogenes, and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the discovery of transforming tumor viruses revealed that cancer arises from altered cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays to measure cell transformation.

topics.label: Oncogenes, tumor suppressor genes, and cell-cycle deregulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the functional classifications of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes and illustrate how their mutations disrupt cell-cycle regulation and normal cell phenotype.

topics.label: Mechanisms of sequence and chromosomal genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the cellular failures in DNA repair, replication proofreading, and mitotic chromosome segregation that generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multi-step tumor progression, hereditary predisposition, and tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the stepwise accumulation of somatic and inherited mutations alters the rate and evolutionary dynamics of tumor development.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture by reviewing learning outcomes, recommending supplementary reading, and previewing the next session.
